why: All 2024-2026 results found (e.g. arXiv:2503.14735, 2506.12684, 2503.12860, 2608.24047) prove Hamiltonicity under toughness bounds only for restricted graph classes (forbidden linear forests like (2P_2 ∪ P_1)-free, degree-sequence conditions), not the general conjecture; the existence of a universal constant t0 for all graphs remains fully open with no new lower/upper bound reported.
